scope: source and stored tiny CPU controls only; actual captures and measurement panels unopened
targeted_tests: extract warm_counts only: four completed vs two skips; inconsistent Adam step rejects
extract observable/rms/vector only: NaN main prediction must be explicitly invalid, not unresolved
extract runtime_guard only: exact absolute deadline and environment controls
execution: AST-extract functions into isolated namespaces; CPU leaf tensors only, no builder imports, models, GRU or CUDA calls
provenance: verify SHA256 only of consumed builder text/JSON and inspected source; no serialized tensor files
verdict_rule: nonfinite observable path accepted is BLOCK; missing future runtime binding is an admission prerequisite; warm-skip amendment changes eligibility and requires honest completed count; all empirical science conditional on independent default gate
